title: Catalogue
description: `docs/test-plan/<area>.toml` in full: one area's use cases, versioned so a future breaking change to this shape is a version bump, not a silent reinterpretation.

Tier.description: The cheapest tier that would catch a regression in a use case's behaviour — `docs/test-plan/README.md`'s own table. Spelled as the exact uppercase token every suite header and catalogue line already uses, so no rename table can drift from it.

Uncovered.description: Why a T0–T3 use case has no covering suite right now. Every field is required: an uncovered marker with no reason, date or bead is not a record, it is a suppression.

UseCase.description: One row of a catalogue: `UC-<area>-NN`, its tier, the behaviour it states, and — only while nothing covers it — why.
